summary: Backend (13/13 pytest) and frontend (all critical flows) PASS on Vanalume. Products (23), categories (7), duet fragrance pairs, /config (payment_configured=false), /orders (duet-bloom qty2=₹3000, aroma-stone rejected 400, unknown product 400, variant multi-line), /inquiries CRUD & validation, /newsletter subscribe+duplicate+422 — all verified. Frontend: Home hero, Duet showcase (5 cards), nav to Shop/About, Shop with 7 categories & all filter-<id> buttons, Add to Cart (drawer opens, count=1, subtotal ₹1,500), inc/dec, empty-checkout inline errors (4), happy-path checkout → cart-done + cart cleared, pillar variant carries into cart line (verified in isolation), aroma-stone Enquire → /contact, About senses + 3 founders, Contact validation + happy submission → contact-success. One minor UX carry-over noted below.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful checkout the drawer switches to the 'done' (Thank You) view. If the user adds another product without first closing the drawer (or before the 300ms setTimeout in close() resets view), the drawer opens back on the stale 'done' view instead of the cart list. The add() action in CartContext only calls setOpen(true) and does not reset the drawer view; also the close() reset is behind a 300ms setTimeout, which is race-prone.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) In CartContext.add or in CartDrawer effect on `open` change, reset the drawer `view` to 'cart' when items are non-empty so a completed order's 'done' view never leaks into the next add-to-cart. Simplest fix: in CartDrawer, add useEffect(() => { if (open && items.length) setView('cart'); }, [open, items.length]).
(Nit) CartDrawer.close(): `setView(items.length ? 'cart' : 'cart')` — both branches are identical; simplify to `setView('cart')`.
(Nit) In backend_test.py TestInquiries.test_create_valid_inquiry `return data['id']` triggers PytestReturnNotNoneWarning — harmless.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/orders happy-path is clean; server-side price computation via PRODUCT_BY_ID prevents client-side price tampering. Good.
server.py razorpay import is at module top and only used when keys are set — safe.
MongoDB `_id` correctly excluded via projection in list_inquiries / list_orders.
catalog.py — 23 products, 7 categories, PRODUCT_BY_ID lookup; aroma stones have price=None and enquire=True so /orders rejects them via HTTP 400 with a friendly message. Good.
CartDrawer.jsx — view-state race after order completion (see frontend_issues above). Minor UX.
Home.jsx DuetShowcase renders exactly 5 duet cards (Awaken, Intimacy, Bloom, Clarity, Equilibrium) matching the request.
ProductCard.jsx correctly branches to Enquire link when product.price is null OR product.enquire is true — aroma stones behave as designed.
All API base URLs read from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (Shop.jsx, CartDrawer.jsx, Contact.jsx) — no hardcoded URLs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (retested in isolation where prior composite run had state carry-over)

test_credentials: None — public site, no auth. Razorpay keys intentionally NOT set; DB-order fallback is expected behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed inquiries, orders and a random newsletter email. No cleanup was performed (data is prefixed for easy identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py already covers all 7 endpoints and can be reused as regression. Frontend flows to sanity-check after any change: (a) POST /api/orders returns amount=3000 for duet-bloom qty=2, (b) Shop renders all 7 filter-<id> buttons and 23 products, (c) pillar variant flows into cart line, (d) stone-ceramic-pot exposes enquire-<id> Link to /contact, (e) checkout in payment-not-configured mode ends at [data-testid=cart-done] and clears cart. Note the CartDrawer done-view race — you may see stale 'done' view text if you test add-to-cart immediately after a checkout in the same session without a page reload; use a fresh localStorage or reload between tests, as shown in the isolated retest.
rca_of_the_issue: Minor cart drawer view carry-over: CartDrawer keeps a local `view` state ('cart'|'checkout'|'done'). After successful order, code sets view='done' and clears items. The only reset path is close() with a 300ms setTimeout. CartContext.add() calls setOpen(true) but does not reset view. If a user (or test) adds a product before close() has fully reset view, the drawer opens on the stale 'done' screen. Reproduction: place order in cart → wait for cart-done → close drawer → immediately add product → drawer briefly shows 'Thank you / Order placed' instead of the newly-added item. Mitigation: add useEffect in CartDrawer that resets view to 'cart' whenever `open` transitions to true with items.length > 0.
